name: DROP: Discrete Reasoning Over Paragraphs
description: DROP is a reading comprehension benchmark requiring discrete reasoning over paragraphs. Models must resolve references across paragraph text and perform mathematical or symbolic operations such as addition, counting, and sorting to arrive at the correct answer.
